mapped_has_a_target.name: mapped_has_a_target
mapped_has_a_target.value: "integration_mappings"."state" <> 'mapped' or ("integration_mappings"."external_field_id" is not null and "integration_mappings"."owning_system" is not null)

journey_closed_has_reason.name: journey_closed_has_reason
journey_closed_has_reason.value: "journey_instances"."closed_at" is null or "journey_instances"."closed_reason" is not null

completion_is_documented.name: completion_is_documented
completion_is_documented.value:
("journey_step_completions"."kind" = 'done' and "journey_step_completions"."outcome" is not null and "journey_step_completions"."outcome" <> '')
        or ("journey_step_completions"."kind" = 'skipped' and "journey_step_completions"."skip_reason" is not null and "journey_step_completions"."skip_reason" <> '')

resolution_is_attributed.name: resolution_is_attributed
resolution_is_attributed.value: "possible_duplicates"."resolved_at" is null or ("possible_duplicates"."resolved_by_id" is not null and "possible_duplicates"."resolution" is not null)

restoration_closed_has_outcome.name: restoration_closed_has_outcome
restoration_closed_has_outcome.value: "restoration_cases"."closed_at" is null or "restoration_cases"."outcome" is not null
